mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (store_id, openid, unionid, name, phone, gender, birthday, avatar, course_balance, points_balance, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{openid}, #{unionid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{avatar}, COALESCE(#{courseBalance},0), COALESCE(#{pointsBalance},0), COALESCE(#{status},1))
